international.headline: 24th India–France naval exercise Varuna begins in France
group2: Paper II: Indian Economy, AP Economy, Science & Technology
facts: The 24th India–France naval exercise Varuna commenced at Toulon Naval Base, France, on September 22, 2026.
The Indian Navy took part with the modernised Talwar-class guided-missile frigate INS Trishul (F43).
India–France naval exercises began in 1983 and received the name Varuna in 2001.
The exercise aimed to improve coordination, interoperability and maritime security cooperation.
international.summary: Varuna-2026 brought the Indian and French navies together for coordinated maritime training.
international.staticLink: Varuna is the bilateral naval exercise between India and France.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The 2026 edition was the 24th; Varuna became the exercise’s official name in 2001.
international.mainsAngle: Assess the contribution of naval cooperation to India–France maritime security relations.

sources.title: 24th India–France Naval Exercise ‘Varuna–2026’ Held in France

international.notes:
# 1. Exercise details
- **What:** **24th India–France naval exercise Varuna**; commenced on **22 September 2026**
- **Status:** **Ongoing**
- **Type:** **Bilateral naval exercise**
- **Countries:** **India** and **France**
- **Venue:** **Toulon Naval Base, France**
- **Indian Navy asset:** Modernised **Talwar-class guided-missile frigate INS Trishul (F43)**
# 2. Background and objective
- **History:** India–France naval exercises began in **1983**; the exercise received the name **Varuna** in **2001**
- **Objective:** Improved coordination, interoperability and maritime security cooperation
- ⚠ **Trap:** The **24th edition** was held in **2026**; **2001** marks the adoption of the name Varuna, not the beginning of the naval exercises.
> Exam angle: Identify the countries, service, edition and venue of the bilateral naval exercise Varuna.

international.headline: World Rhino Day
facts: World Rhino Day is observed on 22 September; the notes say it has been observed since 2010.
The notes identify the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) as the organisation associated with the observance.
The observance draws attention to conservation and protection of all five rhinoceros species.
international.summary: The annual observance highlights efforts to conserve rhinoceroses and protect all five species.
international.prelimsTakeaway: World Rhino Day — 22 September; associated organisation: WWF; observed since 2010, according to the notes.
international.mainsAngle: Conservation of threatened species requires habitat protection and sustained public awareness.
international.notes:
# 1. Observance
- **What:** **World Rhino Day**
- **Date:** **22 September**
- **Observed since:** **2010**, according to the notes
- **Organisation associated:** **World Wildlife Fund (WWF)**
# 2. Objective
- **Focus:** Conservation and protection of **all five rhinoceros species**
> Exam angle: Recall the date, associated organisation and conservation focus of World Rhino Day.

national.canonicalTopic: NIT Srinagar astronomy and astrophysics observatory
national.headline: NIT Srinagar inaugurates a campus observatory for astronomy and astrophysics
facts: The NIT Srinagar Observatory for Astronomy and Astrophysics was inaugurated on September 22, 2026.
It houses a 14-inch Celestron C14 EdgeHD Aplanatic Schmidt–Cassegrain Telescope.
Its stated aims include observational astronomy, astrophysics research, student training and public awareness.
national.summary: The new campus observatory provides facilities for astronomy education, research and public engagement at NIT Srinagar.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The observatory houses a 14-inch Celestron C14 EdgeHD Aplanatic Schmidt–Cassegrain Telescope.
national.mainsAngle: Discuss how institutional research infrastructure can promote scientific training and public awareness.

andhraPradesh.headline: Vijayawada’s Abhyasa School tops Cfore’s budget-school category
facts: Vijayawada-based Abhyasa School ranked first nationally in the Budget Schools category with 949 points in a Cfore survey.
The notes say the award was to be presented in New Delhi on September 22–23.
Cfore’s assessment drew on opinions from 64,567 respondents and considered teaching, teacher competence, leadership, personalised learning, infrastructure, life skills and value for money.
andhraPradesh.summary: Abhyasa School received the top position in the survey’s Budget Schools category; the award presentation was scheduled for September 22–23.
andhraPradesh.staticLink: The ranking used respondent opinions and multiple school-quality and value-for-money parameters.
andhraPradesh.prelimsTakeaway: Abhyasa School is based in Vijayawada and scored 949 points in the Budget Schools category.
andhraPradesh.mainsAngle: The ranking highlights the use of multi-parameter assessments in evaluating access, quality and value in school education.
andhraPradesh.apLink: The ranked school is located in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh.
andhraPradesh.notes:
# 1. Survey result
- **School:** **Abhyasa School**, **Vijayawada**, **Andhra Pradesh**
- **Released by:** **Cfore**
- **Category:** **Budget Schools**
- **Rank:** **First nationally** in the category
- **Score:** **949 points**
- **Award presentation:** Scheduled for **22–23 September** in **New Delhi**

# 2. Assessment basis
- **Respondents:** Opinions of **64,567** respondents
| Basis | Assessment parameters | Assessment parameters |
|---|---|---|
| School quality and value for money | Teaching; teacher competence; leadership; personalised learning; infrastructure | Life skills; value for money |
- ⚠ **Trap:** The school ranked first in the **Budget Schools** category; the award presentation was scheduled, not stated as completed.
> Exam angle: APPSC may ask the survey’s category, top-ranked school, score and its Andhra Pradesh location.
